description: Across email.rs, mailbox.rs, submission.rs, identity.rs, and vacation.rs, the pattern 'if m.is_empty() { Value::Null } else { Value::Object(m) }' and 'if v.is_empty() { Value::Null } else { Value::Array(v) }' appears at least 30 times. This is not wrong but it is repeated without abstraction, which means any future change to the null-vs-omit semantics requires touching every site. The idiomatic approach is a small module-level or crate-level helper: fn map_or_null(m: serde_json::Map<String, Value>) -> Value and fn array_or_null(v: Vec<Value>) -> Value. These are two-liners. The repetition is a maintainability issue: a reviewer checking RFC 8620 §5.3 compliance cannot grep for a single function to audit all set-response null handling.
title: Repeated empty-map-to-null pattern should be a helper function
